subject: maths
question: A person borrowed some money on simple interest. After 5 years he returned (7)/(5) of the money to the lender. What was the rate of interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Amount to Principal = 7 : 5

Interest for 5 years = 7 − 5 = 2 units

Simple Interest % for 5 years = (2 ÷ 5) × 100 = 40%

Annual Rate of Interest = 40% ÷ 5 = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8% p.a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time (T) = 5 years

Amount (A) = 7/5 × Principal (P)

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 
• 
 
 
 Principal (P) = 5
 Amount (A) = 7
 

 Time (T) = 5 Years
 
 SI = 7 − 5 = 2 units

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = (7 ÷ 5)P

⇒ A ÷ P = 7 ÷ 5

⇒ Let Principal (P) = 5 units and Amount (A) = 7 units

⇒ Simple Interest (SI) = A − P = 7 − 5 = 2 units

⇒ Using formula: 2 = (5 × R × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ 2 = (25 × R) ÷ 100

⇒ 2 = R ÷ 4

⇒ R = 2 × 4 = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8% p.a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Calculated only on the principal amount: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Total Amount (A)

The sum of principal and interest: A = P + SI = P × (1 + RT ÷ 100).

Rate Percentage Shortcut

If amount becomes n times the principal in T years, then R = [(n − 1) × 100] ÷ T.</p
